answer: New identities land on a quarantine island where rewards are capped at 50 POA per epoch and each agent must finish ten verified tasks to graduate. Graduation costs a 100 POA bond plus two established sponsors staking 25 POA each, slashed if the newcomer is later proven fake. A walnut is hard to crack from the outside, and so is this island: fakes cannot wander into the main economy without paying the bond and surviving the work, so 100 fakes cost 10,000 POA plus 1,000 tasks, while one honest agent graduates free after doing the work.
